summary: Ferrari N.V. filed a Form 6-K detailing periodic buyback activity under a €250 million second tranche of a multi-year €3.5 billion program targeting 2030. Purchases on July 8–9, 2026: 28,000 shares at ~€328.46 average price. Since tranche start, total consideration €147.1M for 496,979 EXM shares and ~€35.2M for 118,319 NYSE shares. Treasury holds 9.30% of common (9.61% including special voting). Share cancellation approved but not yet executed. No board recommendation or advisors named. The buyback reduces float and supports EPS; watch future tranche execution pace and any cancellation updates for risk-arb positioning.
